hook.en: "Kinabalu is the highest mountain in Malaysia." "Kinabalu is higher than Tahan." One adjective, two forms, and a big difference in meaning.
hook.bm: "Kinabalu is the highest mountain in Malaysia." "Kinabalu is higher than Tahan." Satu kata adjektif, dua bentuk, dan perbezaan maksud yang besar.

bigIdeas.en: Short adjectives add -er/-est; long adjectives use more/most.
bigIdeas.bm: Adjektif pendek menambah -er/-est; adjektif panjang menggunakan more/most.

bigIdeas.en: At, on and in follow patterns for time and place: at 7 p.m., on Monday, in June.
bigIdeas.bm: At, on dan in mengikut pola masa dan tempat: at 7 p.m., on Monday, in June.

bigIdeas.en: Conjunctions join ideas: and (add), but (contrast), because (reason), so (result), although (concession).
bigIdeas.bm: Kata hubung menggabungkan idea: and (tambah), but (bertentangan), because (sebab), so (akibat), although (walaupun).

definition.en: The extreme in a group: the tallest.
definition.bm: Paling dalam satu kumpulan: the tallest.

definition.en: A word showing time, place or direction: at, on, in, under.
definition.bm: Perkataan yang menunjukkan masa, tempat atau arah: at, on, in, under.

definition.en: A word joining clauses: and, but, because, although.
definition.bm: Perkataan yang menghubungkan klausa: and, but, because, although.

question.en: Combine using "although": "It was raining. We played football."
question.bm: Gabungkan menggunakan "although": "It was raining. We played football."

steps.en: Put it before the clause with the problem.
steps.bm: Letakkan sebelum klausa yang menyatakan halangan.

answer.en: Although it was raining, we played football.
answer.bm: Although it was raining, we played football.
